text:
jordan: heads-up — spun up ozma-mini-7b quantized (int8-dl) in shadow on canary, enabled speculative latch (early-accept on top-2) to test latency gains. Quick smoke showed ~18% token throughput improvement, but chat responses have duplicate/repeated tokens around punctuation in a subset of samples. attaching notes.

sasha: can you paste the exact flags you used? curious if latch threshold too low.

jordan: flags: --spec-latch=0.6 --early-accept=top2 --kv-cache=lazy --quant=INT8_DL. Repro snippet:
```bash
./run_infer --model ozma-mini-7b --quant int8-dl --spec-latch 0.6 --early-accept top2 --batch 1 --seq 512
```
Got dups like "Hello, , how are you?" in ~3% of conv samples (n=200).

liam: 3% is small but alarming if regressions cluster by prompt type. Did you run adversarial holdouts?

jordan: ran 50 long-form QA holdouts and 150 short chat prompts. dups mostly in short chat when punctuation immediately follows a token. Example: prompt: "What's the time?" Response: "It's 3:00 , pm." Looks like tokenization/attachment issue post-quant.

sasha: could be greedy early-accept bias. Try raising spec-latch to 0.75 or only allow top1 early accept for punctuation token classes. Also compare logits before and after quant.

ops-bot: deployment: shadow job 4823 finished. metrics: model error-rate 0.9%, avg token latency 46ms -> 38ms with latch.

jordan: ran log-compare, diffs show quantized logits have compressed tail; KL(float32 || int8) over tail tokens ~0.12 on average for first 10 tokens. Planning a tiny ablation: (a) increase latch to 0.75, (b) top1 early-accept only for punctuation token classes, (c) disable lazy kv and re-run.

liam: for eval methodology — recommend: 1k chat-format prompts, stratify by trailing punctuation and token-boundary categories, measure dup-rate, answer-fidelity (automated), and human spot-check 200 samples. Record per-token KL and avg entropy, and capture sampling temperature sensitivity.

sasha: also check sampling temperature; lower T might reduce dups with early accept.

jordan: plan of attack: run 4 configs (control float32, int8 baseline, int8 + latch 0.75, int8 + top1-punct) over 1k prompts each. ETA ~2h on canary cluster. will post CSVs + a quick script to compute token-dupe-rate.

liam: policy: if dup-rate >1% in any config, block rollout. If <=0.5% and latency gains >12%, ok to promote to dedicated shadow.

jordan: noted. kicking off now. uploading results and diffs to the thread when done.

sasha: :thumbsup:

jordan: thanks — pinging @devex in case we need a tokenizer patch if this recurs.
